title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 batters during the Red Sox's 13-1 win over the Oakland Athletics.
The Boston Red Sox secured their ninth consecutive victory and improved to 64-51 after a strong offensive display.
Raymond Burgos made his Red Sox debut, pitching three hitless innings with two strikeouts following Tolle's dominant start.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez actively engage in competitive training camp matchups, enhancing preparation for the 2026 season.
Gonzalez uses intentional trash talk to simulate real-game scenarios against top receivers like Brown.
Gonzalez remains professional amidst contract negotiations, with Patriots reportedly offering a lucrative deal.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman, acquired by the Red Sox, will start a rehab assignment with Triple-A Worcester on Saturday.
Rutschman has been on the injured list since July 20 due to left wrist inflammation, last playing on July 18.
The catcher was acquired from the Orioles for three prospects and Carlos Narvaez during the trade deadline.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' is now streaming on Paramount+, continuing the story of the Nickelodeon series.
Halle Bailey stars in 'You, Me & Tuscany,' a romcom set in Italy, available on Peacock.
'Ted Lasso' Season 4 features Jason Sudeikis coaching a women's team at AFC Richmond, streaming on Apple TV.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet, Boston Red Sox pitcher, is considering a bullpen role after a prolonged injury recovery.
Interim manager Chad Tracy expressed doubt about Crochet returning as a starter this season.
Crochet is open to contributing as a reliever, dependent on approval from Red Sox management.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python named 'Tippy' was found in a Dorchester community food garden near Ellington Street.
Residents reported seeing someone leave the python in a cage before contacting Boston Animal Care and Control.
The python is in good condition at the Roslindale facility; officials seek information about its owner.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Team Blue, led by Tommy DeVito, defeated Team White 22-15 in the Patriots' training camp scrimmage.
DeMario Douglas stood out for Team Blue with six receptions and two touchdowns, showcasing versatility in the offense.
Injury concerns remain as cornerback Carlton Davis is likely out until next week, affecting preseason availability.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich was voted the best town on Cape Cod by over 850 Boston.com readers in an informal poll.
The town features nearly 11 miles of tidal shoreline and over 20 beaches along the Nantucket Sound and Pleasant Bay.
Harwich offers diverse attractions including beaches, conservation areas, community centers, and cultural sites, catering to all ages.

title: DA’s office says prosecutor’s ‘hot mic’ moment in Lindsay Clancy trial was misheard
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Plymouth County DA's Office clarified a 'hot mic' incident was misheard, pertaining to courtroom autopsy photos.
Defense attorney Kevin Reddington accused prosecutors of inappropriate comments during Lindsay Clancy's sobbing in court.
Judge William Sullivan warned against disruptive comments, emphasizing strict monitoring with microphones in the courtroom.

title: Little boy dancing to DJ on Boston Common has hundreds of thousands of new fans
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Four-year-old Chukwuemeka Ikesinachi-Nwogwugwu danced to a DJ's music on Boston Common, gaining 200,000 likes on social media.
The boy's mother, Chidimma Ikesinachi, shared the video online, receiving over 4,000 comments praising his dance moves.
DJ Miss S. Peace held a popup show on Boston Common, where Chukwuemeka's dancing was encouraged by attendee Kelly Werme.
